mechanism.claim: When the completed eight-hour Binance BTC premium-index displacement and BTC return have opposite strict signs during elevated BTC variation, derivatives fair-value demand has not been assimilated by price. Trade BTC in the premium displacement direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of premium-index last close minus first open, opposite the BTC block-return sign
mechanism.why_distinct: PPLAR required a top-quintile one-hour premium impulse, second-hour persistence, bounded BTC under-response and onset logic. HVPCR uses one indivisible fixed eight-hour cross-surface displacement relation, no magnitude tail, no PPLAR event/control clock, and no repair of its unopened economics.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed BTC eight-hour realized-variation rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three conditional premium-price disagreement clocks are absent from Gross9

features.source: 480 exact joined BTCUSDT premium-index and perpetual 1m rows
features.premium_displacement: last premium close minus first premium open
features.disagreement: both strict nonzero and opposite signs
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: fixed nonoverlap; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no premium, disagreement, rank, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
